body.name: \(r_{\mathrm{alt}}(\omega)\)
body.def: \(r_{\mathrm{alt}}(\omega)=P_\omega(r_{\mathrm{alt}}^0)\). At \(\omega_0\), exact arithmetic gives \(\sum_{x=1}^{4}\sum_{a=0}^{1}p_xe_{ax}r^0_{\mathrm{alt},ax}=11/20=B\). Thus \(r_{\mathrm{alt}}^0\) is feasible, its projection equals itself, and \(r_{\mathrm{alt}}(\omega_0)=r_{\mathrm{alt}}^0\).
